name: Unknown BSC swap-bot contract lets anyone swap approved wallets without slippage limits
summary: Unverified contract 0x16d7c6f4, used by an operator's many EOAs to trade for managed wallets, exposes f8c03cc4(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee, amountIn, buyBack, 0, wallet). It pulls amountIn from any wallet that approved it and sells it on PancakeSwap V3 with no minimum output. It then buys the same amount back with the caller's tokens and sends it to the caller. There is no caller authorization. After draining the pool's other side, the attacker called it for 152 approved wallets in three transactions, receiving their TA, WBNB and USD1 for dust.

loss.notes: Gross debits of the 152 approved wallets named as the wallet argument in the three campaign transactions. The wallets received only dust back (24935602 wei USDT and 0.0083 TA in total), which is not netted. TA is illiquid, and the attacker's same-transaction sale moved its price, so TA is valued at realised proceeds: 282180.028682576245452554 USDT net to attacker contract 0x5b0d9b3c in source-1 (DefiLlama quoted 0.102143 before the sale). WBNB and USD1 are valued at DefiLlama quotes. Flash liquidity and the attacker's buy-back inputs are excluded.

ageReset.description: Direct, immutable runtime (constructor immutables: owner 0x6d8bace1, router 0x13f4ea83). The unauthenticated, zero-minimum swap entry point exists from deployment. Wallet approvals only set exposure, and the owner's later calls only withdraw balances.

limitations: The contract has no verified source. The missing caller check and zero minimum output are established from traces and calldata: attacker contracts created at blocks 55013996/55014240/55015921 were served, and the router calls carry amountOutMinimum 0. They are not established from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. In source-1 (block 55014088, index 1), EOA 0x6d77043e calls its contract 0x5b0d9b3c (created at 55013996, 0xc92cde6e...) with 183fc622. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) shows a USDT drain of TA/USDT V3 pool 0xeea4ba3117fbfde6795305eccd795548bfefc4ef, followed by 29 successful CALLs from 0x5b0d9b3c to 0x16d7c6f43df19778e382b7a84bcb8c763971a551 f8c03cc4. First call: tokenIn TA 0x539ae81a, tokenOut USDT, fee 500, amountIn 184600e18 TA, buyBack 0xad78ebc5ac60f8e3b (about 200 USDT), 0, wallet 0x200285592f7bb7b228bdd72189892c4d2887d2b1. The victim does TA.transferFrom(wallet, victim, amountIn). It then calls router 0x13f4ea83 exactInputSingle(TA->USDT, recipient victim, amountOutMinimum 0), which returns 983244 wei, and forwards 983146 wei of it to the wallet. Next it pulls buyBack USDT from msg.sender, calls exactOutputSingle(USDT->TA, amountOut=amountIn, recipient msg.sender) for 989464 wei, and refunds the rest to msg.sender. Nothing ties the wallet or caller to the operator: the caller is a fresh attacker contract. Source-3 (0x66bbc834, 73 calls, WBNB->TA) and source-4 (0x0f5535a1, 50 calls, USD1->TA) repeat this from EOA 0x6d77043e. Normal use: Etherscan txlist for the victim, blocks 54878306..55111808 (3 pages continued at 54921966 and 54984007), returns 24966 transactions from 157 EOAs, 24926 of them successful f8c03cc4 calls with a managed wallet different from the sender. An EOA call cannot move the pool price inside the same transaction, so a direct call sells at the market price and the buy-back returns the tokens. Earliest exercise: parity trace_filter with toAddress=victim over blocks 54878306..55016299 (1379 windows of 100 blocks, all succeeded) finds internal calls to the victim only in source-1, source-3 and source-4: 152 f8c03cc4 frames from the three attacker contracts. Every f8c03cc4 call moves tokens through the victim. Etherscan tokentx for the victim from block 55016008 to latest returns only 5 transfers: owner withdrawals (84bf91bc) of WBNB, USD1 and USDT to 0x6d8bace1 at blocks 55025525/55025534/55025543, and two unsolicited token deposits at 80563544 and 89353898. So there are no later swaps and no later campaign. Identity/age: eth_getCode is empty at 54878305. keccak at 54878306 and 55014087 is the recorded hash (4509 bytes). Source-2 (index 109) is a top-level creation by 0x6d8bace1 whose receipt contractAddress is the victim. The runtime has no DELEGATECALL, and its only 0xff byte lies in the CBOR metadata after offset 4455. Its only other external selectors are 84bf91bc and 90469a9d. 84bf91bc(token, amount) withdraws tokens: 3 calls by 0xd48d772b at 54910340..54910358 (WBNB, USD1, USDT) and 3 at 55025525..55025543 paying 0x6d8bace1. 90469a9d(token) was only called after the campaign (first success 0xf13a856a..., block 55017207). No call alters swap authorization.

Reviewed loss. Decode every successful f8c03cc4 frame in the three campaign traces: 29 (source-1), 73 (source-3) and 50 (source-4) distinct wallet arguments, 152 wallets in total. Sum receipt Transfer logs whose from is one of those wallets. Source-1 has 29 TA debits (logs 17..409) totalling 3576100e18. Source-3 has 73 WBNB debits (logs 301..1165) totalling 408844108058469234202. Source-4 has 50 USD1 debits (logs 21..707) totalling 8748341106082606324013. decimals() is 18 for all three. Wallets received back 24935602 wei USDT (source-1), 117806443654885 wei TA (source-3) and 8241656459531085 wei TA (source-4). In source-1 the attacker contract ends +282180028682576245452554 USDT with zero net TA. TA/USDT pool 0xfa7421f1ed6ad1548316a847e8437af7219a8f18 nets +3575492.063 TA and -282180.0287 USDT, and pool 0xeea4ba31 keeps +607.937 TA. The realised TA unit value is 282180.028682576245452554/3576100. In source-3, attacker contract 0x66bbc834 ends +408474604560099294050 WBNB; in source-4, 0x0f5535a1 ends +8545853888094572280934 USD1. The attacker EOA's txlist shows only these three exploit calls. The later f4f3b200 calls (e.g. 0xf72066f275e853edada564fc51eebfd5991d5022a5a80f271f10b9f5fa22440d) withdraw proceeds.
